name: Royal Unibrew A/S
summary: Royal Unibrew A/S engages in the production of beverages in Denmark, Germany, Norway, Sweden, Italy, the Netherlands, France, Finland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, Belgium, Luxembourg, and internationally. It offers soft drinks under the Faxe Kondi, Jaffa, Lemon Soda, Lorina, Royal Club, Fonti di Crodo, Adelhardt, Frem, Rebæl, Crystal Clear, Sisi, Sourcy Vitamin Water, Borg, Hansa, CB, and Pommac brands, as well as other partner brands.
